title: Korea 10 Day Itinerary: Seoul To Jeju Made Easy
summary: Planning ten days in Korea? Follow this southbound route from Seoul through Jeonju, Gyeongju and Busan, ending on Jeju.

slides.title: Seoul To Jeju, Made Easy

slides.title: Give Seoul Four Days
slides.sub: Use one day for Suwon or Nami Island
slides.voice: Spend four days in Seoul; use one for Suwon or Nami Island.

slides.title: Stay In A Hanok
slides.sub: Stay overnight in a traditional hanok
slides.voice: Sleep in Jeonju's hanok village, then allow extra time for Gyeongju.

slides.title: Two Days, Then Jeju
slides.sub: Spend two days in Busan, then fly to Jeju
slides.voice: After Gyeongju, spend two days in Busan, then fly to Jeju.

slides.title: Explore Both Coasts
slides.sub: A rental car makes Jeju easier
slides.voice: Two days in Jeju covers both coasts; a rental car helps.
